title: The Apprentice's Ink
subtitle: onlyFromCrafting: true
description: Six sheets of paper, and the college can tell a bought one: the
task carries `onlyFromCrafting: true`, so only paper the player
crafted themselves counts. Bought, found, fished or inherited
paper is invisible to the task.
The field is how a quest says 'made it themselves' and means it,
which the college considers the only honest kind of homework.
